sources.note: Captured May 21, 2011; published January 9, 2012. Panuru Sherpa filmed; Alan Arnette published the video for his Seven Summits Alzheimer’s campaign. Audio and the original fundraising titles are not used.

The source page flags non-free soundtrack material: ALL original audio is omitted from this silent edit. The 2014 label follows the source date; no more precise filming date is claimed.
